lines.en: I've looked at your numbers for next year's trade show. The total seems high.
lines.zh: 我看過你做的明年商展的數字了。總額好像很高。

lines.en: It is. The booth alone costs fifteen percent more than last year.
lines.zh: 是很高。光是攤位就比去年貴了百分之十五。

lines.en: Can we save money somewhere else, then?
lines.zh: 那我們可以從別的地方省錢嗎？

lines.en: We could send three people instead of five. That would save about two thousand dollars on hotels.
lines.zh: 我們可以派三個人，不要派五個。這樣飯店大概可以省兩千美元。

lines.en: Three people can't cover a booth for four days, though.
lines.zh: 可是三個人顧不了四天的攤位。

lines.en: What if two more people come for the first two days only? Those are the busiest.
lines.zh: 那如果另外兩個人只去前兩天呢？那兩天最忙。

lines.en: That could work. What about the samples? We gave away a lot last year.
lines.zh: 這樣可以。那樣品呢？我們去年送出去很多。

lines.en: Nearly eight hundred, and only a few of those visitors placed orders.
lines.zh: 將近八百個，可是那些參觀者只有少數人下了訂單。

lines.en: Then let's bring half as many and save them for serious buyers.
lines.zh: 那我們只帶一半，留給真的有意願的買家。

lines.en: All right. I'll update the spreadsheet and send it to you by Wednesday.
lines.zh: 好的。我會更新試算表，星期三前寄給你。

questions.en: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.zh: 說話的人主要在討論什麼？
options: Lowering the cost of an event.
Hiring staff for a new booth.

questions.en: What does the man mean when he says, "Three people can't cover a booth for four days"?
questions.zh: 這位男士說「三個人顧不了四天的攤位」，意思是什麼？
options: The booth would need more staff.
Five people would cost too much.

questions.en: What is suggested about last year's samples?
questions.zh: 關於去年的樣品，可以看出什麼？
options: They ran out on the first day.
They cost about two thousand dollars.
Serious buyers did not like them.
Most of them did not lead to sales.

lines.en: Here's the schedule for Tuesday's interviews for the sales assistant job.
lines.zh: 這是星期二業務助理職缺的面試時間表。

lines.en: Thanks. Four is a good number. Have they all confirmed?
lines.zh: 謝謝。四個人剛好。他們都確認了嗎？

lines.en: Three have. Mr. Ford, at eleven, just emailed. He has a doctor's appointment that morning.
lines.zh: 三個確認了。十一點的 Ford 先生剛寄 email 來。他那天早上要看醫生。

lines.en: Can he come later in the day?
lines.zh: 他可以晚一點來嗎？

lines.en: He asked for the last time slot, so I'll move Ms. Moore from three to eleven. She said either time is fine.
lines.zh: 他想要最後一個時段，所以我會把 Moore 小姐從三點改到十一點。她說哪個時間都可以。

lines.en: Good. Who's joining me on the panel?
lines.zh: 好。誰跟我一起當面試官？

lines.en: Ms. Carter from sales, and I will be there too.
lines.zh: 業務部的 Carter 小姐，我也會在。

lines.en: Fine. Please put the applicants' resumes in my office the day before.
lines.zh: 好。請在前一天把應徵者的履歷放到我辦公室。

lines.en: Of course. Should we also give them a short writing test?
lines.zh: 沒問題。我們也要給他們一個簡短的寫作測驗嗎？

lines.en: Yes, but keep it to twenty minutes. We don't want them to feel rushed.
lines.zh: 要，但控制在二十分鐘內。我們不希望他們覺得很趕。

questions.en: Look at the table. Who will have an interview at 3:00?
questions.zh: 請看表格。誰會在三點面試？

questions.en: Why did one applicant ask to change his time?
questions.zh: 有一位應徵者為什麼要求改時間？
options: He wants to take a writing test.
He has another interview at three.

questions.en: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.zh: 這位男士請這位女士做什麼？
options: Leave some documents in his office.

lines.en: Ms. Varga, I heard some lamps from last week's batch had a problem.
lines.zh: Varga 小姐，我聽說上週那一批有些燈出了問題。

lines.en: Yes. Our inspectors found small cracks in the glass of about forty lamps.
lines.zh: 是的。我們的檢查員發現大約四十盞燈的玻璃有小裂痕。

lines.en: Forty out of how many?
lines.zh: 四十盞是在多少盞裡面？

lines.en: Out of two thousand. None of them left the factory.
lines.zh: 兩千盞裡面。沒有一盞出了工廠。

lines.en: That's good to hear. Do you know what caused it?
lines.zh: 那就好。你們知道是什麼原因嗎？

lines.en: The glass came from a new supplier, and it was thinner than our specification.
lines.zh: 那批玻璃是新廠商供應的，比我們的規格還薄。

lines.en: Will this affect my order for the London stores?
lines.zh: 這會影響我倫敦門市的訂單嗎？

lines.en: It may be two or three days late. We've gone back to our old supplier, and the glass arrives tomorrow.
lines.zh: 可能會晚兩三天。我們已經換回原本的廠商，玻璃明天就到。

lines.en: A few days is fine, as long as every lamp is checked.
lines.zh: 晚幾天沒關係，只要每一盞燈都有檢查就好。

lines.en: Every one will be. I'll send you the test results before we ship.
lines.zh: 每一盞都會檢查。出貨前我會把測試結果寄給你。

questions.en: What problem does the woman report?
questions.zh: 這位女士說明了什麼問題？
options: A shipment went to London by mistake.
Two thousand lamps left the factory late.

questions.en: What caused the problem?
questions.zh: 問題是什麼原因造成的？
options: The old supplier sent the wrong glass.
A material did not meet the requirements.
The order for London was too large.

questions.en: What is probably true about the man's order?
questions.zh: 關於這位男士的訂單，哪一項可能是對的？
options: It may arrive a little later than planned.
It will be sent from a new factory.
It will include forty extra lamps.

lines.en: Hi, this is Mr. Shaw, returning your call about the lease for the new store.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Shaw，回你電話，關於新門市租約的事。

lines.en: I've read the landlord's draft, and most of it looks fine.
lines.zh: 我看過房東的草約了，大部分都沒問題。

lines.en: However, clause seven says you must pay for all repairs to the building, not just inside your store.
lines.zh: 不過，第七條寫說整棟建築的所有修繕都要由你們負責，不只是你們店裡面。

lines.en: That's unusual, and I'd ask them to change it.
lines.zh: 這很不尋常，我會請他們修改。

lines.en: Also, the rent is fixed for only one year. If you plan to stay longer, try to get the same price for three years.
lines.zh: 另外，租金只固定一年。如果你打算待久一點，試著爭取三年都是同樣的價格。

lines.en: I'm in court most of tomorrow, so the best time to reach me is Thursday morning. Thanks.
lines.zh: 我明天大部分時間都在法院，所以最好是星期四早上找我。謝謝。

questions.en: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.zh: 說話者為什麼打這通電話？
options: To ask for help with some repairs.
To change the date of a court case.
To give advice on a rental agreement.

questions.en: What does the speaker say is unusual?
questions.zh: 說話者說什麼很不尋常？
options: Who must pay for repairs to the building.
How much the rent will be.

questions.en: Why does the speaker mention that he will be in court tomorrow?
questions.zh: 說話者為什麼提到他明天會在法院？
options: To show that the case is serious.
To ask the listener to meet him there.
To say the store will open later.
To explain when he can be reached.

lines.en: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the Harbor Trading annual meeting.
lines.zh: 各位晚安，歡迎參加 Harbor Trading 年度大會。

lines.en: Please note two changes to tonight's program.
lines.zh: 請注意今晚的節目有兩項變動。

lines.en: First, the president's opening speech has been moved from six thirty to seven o'clock, because his flight arrived late.
lines.zh: 第一，因為總裁的班機晚到，他的開幕致詞從六點半改到七點。

lines.en: In the meantime, drinks will be served in the hall.
lines.zh: 在這段時間，大廳會提供飲料。

lines.en: Second, the awards will now be given out after dinner, not before.
lines.zh: 第二，頒獎改到晚餐之後，而不是晚餐前。

lines.en: If you are receiving an award, please check in with the staff at the front desk so we can show you to your seat.
lines.zh: 如果您是得獎者，請到前方服務台向工作人員報到，我們會帶您入座。

lines.en: Thank you, and enjoy the evening.
lines.zh: 謝謝大家，祝各位有個愉快的夜晚。

questions.en: Where is the announcement most likely being made?
questions.zh: 這段廣播最可能是在哪裡播出的？

questions.en: Why has the president's speech been moved?
questions.zh: 總裁的致詞為什麼改時間？

questions.en: What are award winners asked to do?
questions.zh: 得獎者被要求做什麼？
options: Give a short speech after dinner.
Speak with the staff at the front desk.
Wait in the hall until seven.

lines.en: This is Mark Lee with your local business news.
lines.zh: 我是 Mark Lee，為您播報地方商業新聞。

lines.en: Harbor Trading, a lamp company based in Taipei, announced today that it will open a branch office in London early next year.
lines.zh: 總部在台北的燈具公司 Harbor Trading 今天宣布，明年初將在倫敦開設分公司。

lines.en: The company's Lantern lamps are already sold in twelve stores in the UK, and sales there have nearly doubled this year.
lines.zh: 該公司的 Lantern 系列燈具已經在英國十二家門市販售，今年當地銷售幾乎翻倍。

lines.en: A spokesperson said the new office will hire about fifteen people, mostly in sales and customer service.
lines.zh: 一位發言人表示，新辦公室將招募大約十五人，主要是業務和客服人員。

lines.en: The company also plans to keep all of its manufacturing in Taiwan.
lines.zh: 該公司也計畫把所有生產都留在台灣。

lines.en: After a short break, we'll have the weather and traffic.
lines.zh: 短暫休息後，我們將為您帶來天氣和交通資訊。

questions.en: What is the news report mainly about?
questions.zh: 這則新聞主要是關於什麼？
options: A new lamp store in Taipei.
A company's plan to expand overseas.

questions.en: What does the speaker say has happened to sales in the UK?
questions.zh: 說話者說英國的銷售怎麼了？

questions.en: What is indicated about the company's lamps?
questions.zh: 關於這家公司的燈，文中提到了什麼？
options: They will continue to be made in Taiwan.
They will soon be made in London.
They are sold in fifteen stores.
They are mostly sold to offices.

lines.en: Hi, everyone. I've asked you here because our new flextime program starts on the first of next month.
lines.zh: 大家好。請大家過來是因為我們新的彈性上班制度下個月一號開始。

lines.en: Under the program, you can start work any time between seven and ten, as long as you work eight hours a day.
lines.zh: 在這個制度下，你可以在七點到十點之間的任何時間開始上班，只要一天工作八小時。

lines.en: Everyone must still be in the office from ten to three, which is when most meetings take place.
lines.zh: 不過，十點到三點之間大家都還是要在辦公室，因為大部分的會議都在這段時間。

lines.en: Before you change your hours, please talk to your manager and fill out the form on the HR website.
lines.zh: 要改變上班時間之前，請先跟你的主管談，並填寫人資網站上的表格。

lines.en: We'll look at how the program is going after three months and make changes if needed.
lines.zh: 三個月後我們會檢討這個制度的狀況，必要時做調整。

lines.en: I'm happy to answer any questions now.
lines.zh: 現在有任何問題，我都很樂意回答。

questions.en: What is the main purpose of the talk?
questions.zh: 這段談話的主要目的是什麼？
options: To change the time of a meeting.
To explain a new program for working hours.

questions.en: When must all employees be at work?
questions.zh: 所有員工什麼時候一定要在公司？
options: From the first of next month.

questions.en: What does the speaker suggest about the program?
questions.zh: 說話者對這個制度暗示了什麼？
options: It may be adjusted in the future.

lines.en: The survey results came in this morning. About six hundred people answered.
lines.zh: 問卷結果今天早上出來了。大約有六百人回答。

lines.en: That's more than we expected. What did they say about the lamp?
lines.zh: 比我們預期的多。他們對這盞燈怎麼說？

lines.en: Most of them love the design. But nearly half think the price is too high.
lines.zh: 大部分的人都很喜歡設計。但將近一半的人覺得價格太高。

lines.en: How high is too high? It's eighty dollars right now.
lines.zh: 多高算太高？現在是八十美元。

lines.en: Most said they'd pay sixty at the most.
lines.zh: 大部分的人說最多只願意付六十。

lines.en: We can't lower it that much without losing money.
lines.zh: 降那麼多我們一定會虧錢。

lines.en: Then maybe we should explain why it's worth more. It lasts much longer than a cheap lamp.
lines.zh: 那也許我們應該說明它為什麼值這個價。它比便宜的燈耐用得多。

lines.en: Good point. We could put that on the box and in our online ads.
lines.zh: 說得好。我們可以把這點寫在盒子上和網路廣告裡。

lines.en: I'll write a few versions of the message by Friday.
lines.zh: 我星期五前會寫幾個版本的文案。

lines.en: Great. I'll show them to the director on Monday.
lines.zh: 太好了。我星期一會拿給總經理看。

questions.en: What did many of the people who answered the survey say?
questions.zh: 許多回答問卷的人說了什麼？
options: The ads are hard to find.

questions.en: Why does the man say, "We can't lower it that much without losing money"?
questions.zh: 這位男士為什麼說「降那麼多我們一定會虧錢」？
options: To ask for a bigger budget.
To reject a large price cut.

questions.en: What will the woman do by Friday?
questions.zh: 這位女士星期五前會做什麼？
options: Prepare several versions of a message.
Change the price on the box.

lines.en: How is the new London office coming along?
lines.zh: 倫敦新辦公室進行得怎麼樣？

lines.en: Quite well. The lights were put in yesterday, and the desks are arriving on schedule.
lines.zh: 相當順利。燈昨天裝好了，桌子也會照計畫送到。

lines.en: Good. Is the internet company still coming on the fifth?
lines.zh: 很好。網路公司還是五號來嗎？

lines.en: That's the problem. They called this morning and said they can't come until the ninth.
lines.zh: 問題就在這裡。他們今天早上打來說九號才能來。

lines.en: But the staff are moving in before that.
lines.zh: 可是員工在那之前就要搬進去了。

lines.en: Yes. I think we should wait a few days. People can't do much without the internet.
lines.zh: 對。我覺得我們應該等幾天。沒有網路大家做不了什麼事。

lines.en: I agree. Let's move everyone in the day after it's set up.
lines.zh: 我同意。網路裝好的隔天再讓大家搬進去。

lines.en: Fine. And the opening party can stay on the same day.
lines.zh: 好。開幕派對就維持原本的日期。

lines.en: Will Mr. Hughes be able to come to the party?
lines.zh: Hughes 先生能來參加派對嗎？

lines.en: He said yes. He'll bring a few of his store managers, too.
lines.zh: 他說會來。他還會帶幾位門市店長一起來。

questions.en: Look at the table. Which task will now take place on May 10?
questions.zh: 請看表格。哪一項工作現在會在五月十日進行？

questions.en: Why does the woman want to wait?
questions.zh: 這位女士為什麼想等？
options: Employees need an internet connection to work.
The lights have not been put in yet.
The desks have not arrived yet.

questions.en: What does the woman indicate about Mr. Hughes?
questions.zh: 關於 Hughes 先生，這位女士透露了什麼？
options: He cannot come until the ninth.
He will help with the move.

lines.en: Thanks for joining us, Mr. Hughes. Our contract ends in March, so we wanted to talk about renewing it.
lines.zh: Hughes 先生，謝謝您參加。我們的合約三月到期，所以想談談續約的事。

lines.en: Happy to. Sales have been good, so I'd like to renew for another three years.
lines.zh: 很樂意。銷售一直不錯，所以我想再續三年。

lines.en: That should be fine. Are there any changes you would like to make?
lines.zh: 這應該沒問題。您有想要修改的地方嗎？

lines.en: Just one. I'd like the right to sell the lamps online in the UK, not only in my stores.
lines.zh: 只有一個。我希望有權在英國的網路上賣這些燈，不只是在我的門市。

lines.en: We already sell online there through our own website.
lines.zh: 我們已經透過自己的網站在那邊網路販售了。

lines.en: I know. But many of my customers look for the lamps on my website first.
lines.zh: 我知道。但我很多顧客會先在我的網站上找這些燈。

lines.en: What if he could sell online, but not at a lower price than yours?
lines.zh: 如果他可以在網路上賣，但價格不能比你們低呢？

lines.en: I could accept that. That way we wouldn't be competing on price.
lines.zh: 這我可以接受。這樣我們就不會在價格上互相競爭。

lines.en: That seems fair to me.
lines.zh: 我覺得這很公平。

lines.en: Good. I'll add a clause and send a new draft to both of you by Friday.
lines.zh: 好。我會加一條條款，星期五前把新的草約寄給兩位。

questions.en: Why are the speakers meeting?
questions.zh: 說話的人為什麼開會？
options: To open more stores in the UK.
To lower the price of the lamps.

questions.en: What does the client want to change?
questions.zh: 客戶想要修改什麼？
options: He wants to sell the lamps on the internet.
He wants to close his stores.

questions.en: What does the lawyer suggest?
questions.zh: 律師提出什麼建議？
options: A contract that ends in March.
A new website for the client.

lines.en: Good morning, and welcome to today's seminar on handling customer complaints.
lines.zh: 早安，歡迎參加今天處理客訴的研討會。

lines.en: I'm your instructor, and we'll be together until four o'clock.
lines.zh: 我是你們的講師，我們會一起上到四點。

lines.en: This morning, we'll listen to some real phone calls and talk about what went well and what didn't.
lines.zh: 今天上午，我們會聽一些真實的電話錄音，討論哪裡做得好、哪裡做得不好。

lines.en: After lunch, you'll work in pairs and practice with each other.
lines.zh: 午餐後，你們會兩人一組互相練習。

lines.en: Please keep your phones on silent, and if you need to take a call, step out into the hallway.
lines.zh: 請把手機調成靜音，如果需要接電話，請到走廊上。

lines.en: One more thing: lunch isn't in this room. It will be served in the restaurant on the first floor at noon.
lines.zh: 還有一件事：午餐不在這間教室。中午會在一樓的餐廳供應。

lines.en: Let's begin by introducing ourselves.
lines.zh: 我們先從自我介紹開始。

questions.en: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.zh: 聽眾最可能是什麼人？

questions.en: What will the listeners do in the afternoon?
questions.zh: 聽眾下午會做什麼？

questions.en: What does the speaker say about lunch?
questions.zh: 說話者對午餐說了什麼？
options: It will start at four o'clock.
It will be served in another place.
It is not included in the seminar.
It will be brought to the hallway.

lines.en: Hello, this is Greg from Southern Metals, calling for your purchasing team.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Southern Metals 的 Greg，打給貴公司的採購團隊。

lines.en: I wanted to let you know that the price of steel has gone up a lot this month.
lines.zh: 想通知你們，這個月鋼材的價格大幅上漲。

lines.en: Starting on June first, the lamp stands you order from us will cost twelve percent more.
lines.zh: 從六月一日起，你們向我們訂的燈架會貴百分之十二。

lines.en: However, if you place your next order before the end of May, we'll keep the current price.
lines.zh: 不過，如果你們在五月底前下下一筆訂單，我們會維持現在的價格。

lines.en: I'd also suggest ordering a larger amount, since prices may rise again in the fall.
lines.zh: 我也建議多訂一些，因為秋天價格可能還會再漲。

lines.en: Please call me back, or just reply to the email I sent this morning.
lines.zh: 請回電給我，或直接回覆我今天早上寄的 email。

questions.en: What is the main purpose of the message?
questions.zh: 這則留言的主要目的是什麼？
options: To apologize for a late order.
To offer a new kind of lamp stand.
To warn about a price increase.

questions.en: How can the listener avoid paying more?
questions.zh: 聽者要怎麼樣才能不用多付錢？

questions.en: Why does the speaker recommend a larger order?
questions.zh: 說話者為什麼建議多訂一些？
options: He has extra stands to sell.
His factory will close in the fall.

lines.en: Before we finish tonight, I have one more announcement.
lines.zh: 今晚結束前，我還有一件事要宣布。

lines.en: As many of you know, Ms. Carter has led our sales team for the past five years.
lines.zh: 很多人都知道，Carter 小姐過去五年帶領我們的業務團隊。

lines.en: Starting next month, she will become our new head of international sales.
lines.zh: 從下個月開始，她會成為我們新的國際業務主管。

lines.en: In that role, she'll oversee our partners in the UK and help us find new markets in Asia.
lines.zh: 在這個職位上，她會負責管理我們在英國的合作夥伴，並協助我們在亞洲開拓新市場。

lines.en: I want to thank her for her hard work and her excellent ideas.
lines.zh: 我要感謝她的努力和許多很棒的點子。

lines.en: Her old position will be filled by Dan Wu, who has been on the team for four years.
lines.zh: 她原本的職位將由在團隊待了四年的 Dan Wu 接任。

lines.en: Please join me in congratulating them both.
lines.zh: 請大家和我一起恭喜他們兩位。

questions.en: What is the speaker mainly announcing?
questions.zh: 說話者主要在宣布什麼？
options: The opening of an office in Asia.

questions.en: What will Ms. Carter be responsible for?
questions.zh: Carter 小姐將負責什麼？

questions.en: What is most likely true about Dan Wu?
questions.zh: 關於 Dan Wu，哪一項最可能是對的？
options: He will take over the sales team.
He will move to the UK.
He joined the company last year.
He will leave the company next month.

lines.en: Attention, passengers on Flight 208 to London.
lines.zh: 搭乘 208 班機前往倫敦的旅客請注意。

lines.en: Because of strong winds in London, this flight will now leave at four fifteen, about two hours later than planned.
lines.zh: 由於倫敦風勢強勁，本班機將改為四點十五分起飛，比原定時間晚了大約兩小時。

lines.en: The boarding gate has also changed from gate twelve to gate twenty.
lines.zh: 登機門也從十二號改到二十號。

lines.en: Passengers with connecting flights in London should speak with an airline agent at the service desk near gate fifteen.
lines.zh: 在倫敦需要轉機的旅客，請到十五號登機門附近的服務台洽詢航空公司人員。

lines.en: Meal coupons are also available there.
lines.zh: 那裡也可以領取餐券。

lines.en: We are sorry for the delay, and we thank you for your patience.
lines.zh: 造成延誤，我們深感抱歉，感謝您的耐心等候。

questions.en: What has caused the delay?
questions.zh: 是什麼造成了延誤？

questions.en: Where should passengers with connecting flights go?
questions.zh: 需要轉機的旅客應該去哪裡？
options: To a desk near gate fifteen.
To the airline office in London.

questions.en: What can passengers get at the service desk?
questions.zh: 旅客在服務台可以拿到什麼？
options: A seat on an earlier flight.
